name: Desperate Prayer
summary: In Ironforge, dwarven priests come of age through training in healing and survival. High Priest Rohan sends acolytes through the Deeprun Tram to Stormwind, where High Priestess Laurena guides their passage into deeper mysteries.

sections.title: A Summons to Stormwind
sections.body: In Ironforge's Mystic Ward, High Priest Rohan guides dwarven initiates devoted to the Holy Light. When an acolyte shows discipline and faith, Rohan sends them southwest to Stormwind. Human and dwarven clerics share close spiritual ties, and advanced teaching is centered in Stormwind City's grand halls.

sections.title: The Cathedral of Light
sections.body: The Deeprun Tram carries acolytes to Stormwind, where they climb to Cathedral Square. Inside the Cathedral of Light, High Priestess Laurena tests candidates on behalf of the Church. She teaches the desperate prayers a priest calls upon in battle: appeals for divine intervention when strength fails and death draws near.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
faq.answer: High Priest Rohan sends you. He presides over the dwarven clergy in the Hall of Mysteries, within Ironforge's Mystic Ward.

faq.q: Where do I need to go to complete this?
faq.answer: Travel to the Cathedral of Light in the heart of Cathedral Square, Stormwind City. High Priestess Laurena waits inside the main sanctuary.

faq.q: What is the best way to get to Stormwind from Ironforge?
faq.answer: Take the Deeprun Tram, built by the gnomes, from eastern Ironforge to Stormwind's Dwarven District.

faq.q: Why must a dwarf priest go to a human city to train?
faq.answer: The Church of the Holy Light is rooted in human tradition, and its chief seat of learning is the Cathedral of Light. Dwarven and human priesthoods work in tandem, sharing teachings and traditions across the Alliance.

faq.q: What ability does this training unlock?
faq.answer: This training begins your study of Desperate Prayer, an instantaneous plea for self-preservation that rapidly restores a priest's health in dire danger.
No combat is involved. You make a pilgrimage and serve as an emissary, traveling safely from Ironforge to Stormwind to present yourself to High Priestess Laurena.

angles.text: As a priest, you leave local training in Ironforge and enter the broader hierarchy of the Church of the Holy Light.
As a young Khaz Modan dwarf, your journey to Stormwind offers an early glimpse of human culture, grand architecture, and shared spiritual devotion.
As an Alliance member, you see the spiritual bond and institutional cooperation between Ironforge and Stormwind in the shared training of priests.
